title: OAuth connector permission failures
symptoms: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, missing OAuth scope when calling tools
guidance: Compare consented scopes with the connector's required scopes; do not log access tokens.

title: Quota and rate limiting
guidance: Check per-minute quota and rate of requests; back off and use jitter.

title: Retrieval and grounding regressions
symptoms: Missing grounding citations; retrieval context not injected
guidance: Check retrieval enablement, document visibility and grounding tests.

title: Unknown incident escalation
guidance: Gather timestamps, correlation IDs and a minimal reproduction before escalation.
